question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Toxic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"toxic"** means something that is poisonous or harmful to living beings. (विषैला)

 
 
• **Example: **The factory was closed down due to its** toxic** waste polluting the river.
 
 
 
• **"Lethal"** refers to something that is sufficient to cause death; deadly. (घातक)
 
 
• **Example: **The venom of some snakes is so** lethal **that it can kill a human within minutes.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a synonym of **'toxic'** is **'lethal'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Laudatory** (प्रशंसात्मक): Expressing praise.

 
 
• **Example:** The laudatory reviews boosted the morale of the team.
 
 
 
• **Lanky** (दुबला-पतला): Tall and thin, often with an awkward appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The lanky teenager towered over his peers.
 
 
 
• **Licit** (कानूनी): Lawful or permitted by law.
 
 
• **Example:** The licit trade practices ensured the company's growth.
